subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be scoped to documenting current pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable TUI send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: Current main already gets partial newline composition from pi-tui, but the remaining configurable behavior would create a public keybinding/config surface where repository policy requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Document Current Behavior First
options.body: Update TUI docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable bindings to a separate explicit decision.

options.title: Approve A TUI Keybinding Bridge
options.body: Wire pi-tui keybinding configuration into `openclaw tui` with focused tests, docs, and compatibility-safe configuration behavior.

options.title: Close As Sufficient
options.body: Treat dependency-level newline support as enough and explicitly decline docs/help/config follow-up for this issue.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable bindings to a separate explicit decision.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current TUI/editor/docs history and already provided prior issue review context for this exact scope.
